fact: EPRA reports a SAIFI of 3.96 interruptions per customer for the year ended June 2024, against 3.75 the year before and a target of 2.15; monthly values ran from 2.81 to 5.03.
title: Energy & Petroleum Statistics Report for the Financial Year Ended 30th June 2024
publisher: Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA), Kenya
